commands.short: Check the tools, versions and configuration tkt needs
Describe every command, flag, result and error code as JSON
commands.long:
tkt schema prints a JSON description of tkt for programs that drive it: every
command with its arguments, flags and result fields, the exit statuses and
error codes, and the environment variables tkt reads. It is built from the same
definitions as the help, so the two always agree.

Without --json it prints the description itself; with --json it is the result
of the usual envelope.

environment.name: TKT_FORMAT
environment.description: json makes every command print the JSON envelope; text, or unset, prints text

environment.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
environment.description: tkt logs every command it runs to $XDG_STATE_HOME/tkt/tkt.log (default ~/.local/state/tkt/tkt.log)

environment.name: HERDR_ENV
environment.description: herdr sets it to 1 inside its panes; start, run, resume, done and wait need it

environment.name: HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID
environment.description: the herdr workspace where tkt opens tabs

environment.name: HERDR_TAB_ID
environment.description: the tab tkt runs in; tkt done refuses to close it

environment.name: HERDR_PANE_ID
environment.description: the pane tkt runs in; tkt never starts an agent in it

environment.name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
